scope: Proposition 7.3 (All rectangular laws) of the manuscript “An infinite finitely presented simple amenable group” (preprints/An-Infinite-Finitely-Presented-Simple-Amenable-Group-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 253 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 810ff1d8e0901a21), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 42. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For a sufficiently large fixed initial window n0, its true table and the finite geometric tables described above imply R(n) for every n. In particular every finite family of aligned rectangular tests has its actual central law in b G.
